data_fields.name: attack_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: attackMax from the combat restriction (no literal in this file)

best_idea: Pick one group aggression level for the enemy pack from its force ratio and damage-to-life ratio, let each enemy commit only if its gate passes at that level, and override to all-in when the unblocked damage would kill.
decision_why: The level ladder and lethal all-in check fit Frankendom's AI brain (row 2) and the attack cap of 3; the card-value terms, the random roll and the wall-clock thread pool do not fit replay, one engine or a fixed tick.
acceptance: At low player health with three enemies whose unblocked damage would kill, all three attack (level 5); in a healthy 1-vs-3 fight only unblockable attackers commit and never more than 3 at once (server test, fixed seed).
